findings.title: Estimated bills arrive as a surprise and take days to put right

coherence.why: P6 has never had one, but is on a smart meter with a fixed payment, so the finding is scoped to manual readers.

findings.title: Reading reminders arrive when people cannot act on them

adequacy.why: 4 of 6 with a specific occasion; P2's is a general account.

coherence.why: P5 says they never miss one, and described the last reading they sent.

relevance.why: P3's occasion was while the smart meter was offline, a rarer context.

findings.title: People photograph the meter as proof before sending a reading

adequacy.why: 3 of 6, all with a specific occasion.

opportunities.title: Help manual readers send a reading at a moment they can act on it, before an estimate is issued
Help people show the reading they sent is correct without a separate email or call

recommendations.title: Let people choose when the reading reminder arrives
Accept a meter photo with the reading and keep it on the account
recommendations.shown_in_behaviour: P1, P2 and P5 already take the photo, and P5's settled a dispute in one email (00:01:03).
